Working Hours
TechNova operates on a Hybrid work model to offer flexibility while maintaining team
cohesion. Full-time employees are expected to work 3 days from the Bengaluru office

4. Earned Leave
Earned Leave (EL), also known as Paid Time Off (PTO), is provided for employees to
rest, recuperate, and take extended vacations. Employees accrue Earned Leave at a
rate of 1.66 days per month, totaling 20 days per calendar year.
Employees are encouraged to utilize their Earned Leave for maintaining a healthy
work-life balance. Yes, up to 10 days of earned leave can be carried forward to the
next calendar year. Earned leave can be encashed at the time of separation from the
company, subject to a maximum cap of 30 days.
